title: wom pack
description: Collection of vanilla+ fabric mods to play with my friends :)
body:
# STEP INTO WOM CRAFT

Vanilla+ modpack with mostly quality of life, UI enhancement, and performance mods. There is updated world generation from explorify, hearths, and blooming biospheres. Future updates will likely include light tech mods like Create.


### Fork of [DB's Minecraft REFINED](https://modrinth.com/modpack/dbs-minecraft-refined)

Additional mods:

[carry on](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on)

[armored elytra](https://modrinth.com/datapack/elytra-armor)

[farmers delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)

[storage delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/storage-delight)

[jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)

[just enough items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)

Mods that require a link in the description:
https://vanillatweaks.net
